changelog: Easy setup for new installs: a Getting-started box on the settings page with numbered steps and copyable tuner/guide links built from your own server address, plus a one-click "Apply this theme to Jellyfin's Live TV guide" button that writes the theme CSS into Branding (keeping any CSS already there) so Jellyfin's own guide shows channel names with no copy-paste. Generic descriptions (no Dayz-specific paths). Nothing else changed from 0.3.0.0.
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
